## ProduSemy

<div class="project-entry">
<div class="project-title">Productivity and Semantics in Language Evolution</div>

**University of Passau, 2025-2027**

I work as a postdoctoral researcher at the Chair of Multilingual Computational Linguistics on the ProduSemy project. My contribution centers on linguistic evolution, comparative and quantitative analysis, and computational approaches to cross-linguistic patterns.

[CALC Lab](https://calclab.org) | [University of Passau profile](https://www.geku.uni-passau.de/mcl/team/carlo-meloni)
</div>

## Syntactic hierarchy in linguistic evolution

<div class="project-entry">
<div class="project-title">PhD research on clause linkage</div>

**University of Zurich, 2021-2025**

My doctoral research investigated the emergence and diachronic behaviour of clause-linkage structures from a phylogenetic perspective. The dissertation is titled *Syntactic Hierarchy in Linguistic Evolution: A Phylogenetic View of Clause-Linkage*.

[Dissertation record](https://www.zora.uzh.ch/handle/20.500.14742/238107)
</div>

## Neural proto-language reconstruction

<div class="project-entry">
<div class="project-title">Ab Antiquo</div>

With Shauli Ravfogel and Yoav Goldberg, I worked on neural approaches to proto-language reconstruction. The resulting paper, *Ab Antiquo: Neural Proto-language Reconstruction*, appeared at NAACL 2021.

[ACL Anthology](https://aclanthology.org/2021.naacl-main.353/)
</div>
